query: For an 87-year-old woman: among females aged 82–92 with AKI, what is the 25th percentile of first ICU LOS (days)?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY icustays.los) AS percentile_25 FROM patients JOIN icustays ON patients.subject_id = icustays.subject_id WHERE patients.gender = 'F' AND patients.anchor_year = 87 AND patients.anchor_year_group BETWEEN 82 AND 92 AND icustays.los IS NOT NULL;
